notes: .pre-commit-hooks.yaml is read: it is pre-commit's second file format (a hook repository's manifest, what `pre-commit validate-manifest` checks), its entries are the hooks a config's repos[*].hooks[*].id names, and without it the pre-commit subject is one config of 14 hooks

lefthook is tier A: `lefthook dump --format json` (lefthook 1.13.6) run on each config alone, as the lefthook.yml of a fresh scratch repository, names the hooks, commands, scripts and jobs as the tool loaded them; which top-level keys are lefthook's own options and not hooks is read from the JSON schema the lefthook binary embeds (every property that is not a #/$defs/Hook); the tool writes no line, so each name is joined to its written line by a yq v4.53.3 decode (--header-preprocess=false, which keeps a file's leading comments in the line count); all 5 configs were accepted; the 2 jobs of .lefthook.yml's `lint & test` group carry no name, in the tool's output or fathom's, and are not entities

not claimed: lefthook.json and lefthook.toml (the dialect decodes YAML); a job nested more than three group levels deep; lefthook's extends, remotes and source_dir and pre-commit's repo and rev (cross-file and cross-repository references, L3, not in the target); a command reached only through a YAML merge key (<<:) is not read
per-file times exclude the one-time grammar compile (an untimed warm-up extraction precedes timing)

pre-commit is tier C: pre-commit validate-config is absent on the measuring machine (w6 triage 2026-09-29, no installs), so .pre-commit-config.yaml and .pre-commit-hooks.yaml are read by a Ruby Psych reference parse (Psych 3.1.0, libyaml, ruby 2.6.10: calibration/oracles/lefthook-dump/precommit_psych.rb), which caps that subject, and so the reading's L1, at good; the lefthook subject alone reads L1 excellent (27 of 27 at tier A)

subjects: evilmartians/lefthook v1.13.6 (sparse checkout of its lefthook configs; the connector never reads testdata/ and tests/, where most of the repository's configs are), so fathom sees 5 configs (.lefthook.yml and the four under examples/, 27 definitions); pre-commit/pre-commit-hooks v6.0.0: its .pre-commit-config.yaml (14 hooks) and its .pre-commit-hooks.yaml manifest (34 hook definitions)
